# guix Provider

Build Guix System images and reconcile manually commissioned hosts through mDNS and SSH. Requires a Linux runner, Guix, and Avahi.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "guix" {
  artifact_directory = "${path.root}/.guix-artifacts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `artifact_directory` (String) Persistent local directory for per-resource image GC roots. Defaults to .guix-artifacts under the OpenTofu working directory.
- `ssh` (Attributes) Default SSH credentials, also used for hostname imports. Host resources may override the entire object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh`

Required:

- `host_key` (String) Pinned host identity as one OpenSSH public key, distinct from the management key.

Optional:

- `identity_file` (String) Path to an unencrypted management private key on the runner.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to 22.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Unencrypted management private key, for example tls_private_key.management.private_key_openssh. Exactly one of private_key or identity_file is needed.
- `user` (String) SSH user. Defaults to root; other users require passwordless sudo for Guix deployment.
